description: The RIDE Bikes FAT Series is perfect when the smooth route is not the fun route. Wide rubber and stable geometry turn rough pavement, gravel, sand, and light snow into good surprises instead of scary moments. You stay planted, comfortable, and in control while the motor flattens hills and headwinds.
